name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Qiskit program that prepares the 5-qu
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Qiskit program that prepares the 5-qubit W state exactly (using controlled rotations) and verifies it by printing the statevector amplitudes of the basis states with a single 1. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
